lines.text: She brought balloons to study group!
She brought balloons to study group. So extra.

data.define: Used for someone who is dramatic or over the top for small things.

example.text: She brought balloons to study group. So extra.

misuse.why: It sounds like you mock them.

hook.text: She brought balloons to study group!

publish.title: What does "extra" mean?
publish.value: Extra = Doing way too much. Example: "She brought balloons to study group. So extra." (very casual English, US).
